summary: Generated a strict uplink-only EM410 temperature Profile with fixed fPort handling.

fPortPolicy.citation: Both prepared Issue payloads explicitly declare fPort 85

evidenceMatrix.officialDocument: TLV 03/67 carries signed int16 little-endian temperature in tenths of a degree Celsius
evidenceMatrix.decoder: Reads bytes 2-3 as signed int16 little-endian and divides by 10
evidenceMatrix.rationale: Positive and negative known payloads reproduce the documented values
